title: Real-code evidence search
description: Read-only search for what the original code really was: link-map call tree and unit layout, header inlines, matched callers of an inline, and pinned Twilight Princess / Wind Waker JSystem sources.
status_message: Reads the host game checkout ($ORCH_GAME_HOST_REPO_ROOT) and $ORCH_GAME_STATE_DIR/refs/jsystem; parsed map and symbols are cached by mtime and size.
limitations: The CodeWarrior link map lists each symbol once, under its first reference, so map-calls omits callees referenced earlier in the link.
map-calls and map-unit need an original link map (SMS has mario.MAP; Melee has none and reports unavailable).
usage is a text match on the member name inside report-matched functions; it does not resolve overloads or receiver types.
jsystem needs refs fetched with _impl/gamecube/tools/fetch_jsystem_refs.sh (commits pinned in refs.lock.json).

usage.agent_guidance: Use to find real evidence (callees, emitted inlines and weak functions, header inline bodies, matched usage, JSystem references) before keeping a source-shape edit.
